# Support

If you need help using IBM QDMI Device, ask in the
[issue tracker](https://github.com/munich-quantum-software/ibm-qdmi-device/issues).

Before reporting a problem:

1. Consult the
   [usage guide](https://ibm-qdmi-device.readthedocs.io/en/latest/api.html) for
   supported operations and hardware validation status.
2. Search existing issues for the same problem.
3. Create a minimal reproducible example.
4. Use the bug-report form. Include expected and actual behavior, the operating
   system, package, compiler and Python versions, and relevant build output.

Use the feature-request form to propose improvements. Describe the problem,
proposed solution, and alternatives you considered.

Remove API keys, instance identifiers, job identifiers, and private backend
metadata from public reports. Report vulnerabilities through the
[security policy](https://github.com/munich-quantum-software/ibm-qdmi-device/blob/main/.github/SECURITY.md).
